name: scroll-animation-default
blurb: Gallery layout with images revealing on scroll in a columned layout.
description: A section component rendering a three-column image gallery with scroll-triggered reveal animations. Images fade in and slide as the user scrolls; uses ScrollAnimation internally.
use_when: A portfolio or image gallery section that should animate media into view progressively as the user scrolls.
avoid_when: When you need to customize animations, image sources, or number of columns at runtime — this is a fixed demo layout.
a11y: Images have empty alt attributes and are not described. Scroll animation is not controllable via keyboard.
